tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring peanut butter on a plane?

travelTips: Peanut butter is classified as a liquid/gel because it is spreadable. Carry-on jars must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less. Larger jars must go in checked baggage.

faq.question: Is peanut butter allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Peanut Butter is restricted in carry-on luggage. Peanut butter is classified as a liquid/gel because it is spreadable. Carry-on jars must be 3.4 oz (100 ml) or less. Larger jars must go in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can you pack peanut butter in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Peanut Butter is allowed in checked bags. Peanut butter is allowed in checked baggage in any size.
